messages:
deploybot: Starting scheduled migration window MIG-2026-3642 for service-user-profiles. Planned steps: 1) deploy schema change (add profile_flags), 2) quiesce writes, 3) backfill in waves, 4) schema swap. Holdpoint at step 3 (quiesce) — manual ack required. Pinning runtime to service-v2.3.2 during window. Rollback path: immediate backout + replay, feature-flag fallback. Keep an eye on read-replica lag dashboards.

maya: reading, thanks. what's the plan for the backfill batch size?

dan: plan is conservative waves but default batch is 10k rows/s. Recommend first wave much smaller to avoid replica lag. I'll watch the replica-lag grafana.

oliver: if replica lag > 500ms for more than 2 minutes, we should pause and consider abort then fallback to read-from-primary only for writes.

maya: can we set an env override to reduce batch size for wave1?

dan: yes — we'll set MIG_BATCH=2000 for waves 1-3, then evaluate. command to apply:
```bash
kubectl set env deploy/migration MIG_BATCH=2000 -n prod
```

jen: I'll prep release notes and include explicit rollback steps and the feature-flag escape hatch (profile_flags_v2). will add links to ops runbook.

sre-oncall: oncall here — will page if latency hit or if lag > 800ms. also add an escape hatch to flip the feature flag to off quickly. who's going to run the manual ack?

deploybot: Holdpoint reached: waiting for manual ack from @maya or @dan. To ack: `/deploybot ack 3642008888`

maya: ack — proceeding to quiesce in 30s :thumbsup:

deploybot: Quiesce initiated. Logs: `quiesce: success, writes paused at 2026-03-22T13:00:30Z`. Backfill wave 1 started (MIG_BATCH=2000).

dan: observed replica lag spike to 820ms within 45s of start. pausing backfill, reducing batch to 500, and switching read routing to primary-only for critical reads. issuing commands now.

oliver: confirm rollback criteria: if lag stays >500ms for >5m OR error rate >1% for reads, we abort and execute rollback-playbook v1.2.

maya: mitigation applied — batch=500. lag trending down (now ~220ms). will continue with conservative waves and escalate if needed.

jen: release-notes draft published (internal): https://redwood.internal/docs/mig-3642 (placeholder). includes step-by-step rollback and how to flip `profile_flags_v2` to false.

deploybot: Backfill waves complete. Pre-swap checks: health=ok, replicas caught up, critical SLOs within threshold. Performing schema swap.

deploybot: Migration complete. Cutover tag: service-v2.3.2.2. Post-checks: 200/200 health, replica lag nominal. Closing window. :tada:

jen: thanks all — I'll push the final release notes and update the changelog.

sre-oncall: verified no active alerts, removing pager watches. nice job.

dan: leaving one follow-up action: add a small synthetic traffic test to post-cutover smoke for next run (ticket created).
